$comment: Runtime-only invariants: files contain no NUL and use at most 1 MiB per file and 5 MiB total decoded UTF-8 bytes; portable URLs exclude credentials, HTTP request URLs exclude query strings, credential fields and process environments use environment references; project resource references, duplicate identities, and manifest parity follow projectResourcesSchema; polling needs exactly one status URL source, ordered intervals, and disjoint terminal values; sandbox destinations are unique after relative-path normalization; HTTP body_encoding requires a body, and raw bodies are strings; stream incremental output pointer and mode appear together; WebSocket timeouts nest, pointers are distinct, and authorization headers use secret references; callback triggers use POST or PUT without a body, and fetch templates use GET; regex checks must compile, and threshold checks need at least one comparison; source file parity and hashes require resolvePortableProject.
